distractorExplanations.D: Fibrocartilage has coarse type I collagen bundles and rows of chondrocytes rather than a smooth zoned articular matrix.

prompt: Identify the tissue or dominant lining pattern in this unfamiliar microscope field. Write the most specific practical answer.
explanation: This whole-joint field shows articular cartilage on bone bordering a true joint space, the defining architecture of a synovial joint. Functionally, a freely movable synovial joint is a diarthrosis; those terms belong to structural and functional classification systems, respectively.

distractorExplanations.B: A symphysis is united by fibrocartilage and has no true synovial cavity.
distractorExplanations.C: A fibrous synarthrosis is bridged by dense connective tissue and lacks articular cartilage plus a synovial cavity.
distractorExplanations.D: Hyaline cartilage may cover the articular surfaces, but the cavity-and-capsule architecture identifies the whole specimen as a synovial joint.

subject: histology
prompt: Identify the tissue or dominant lining pattern in this unfamiliar microscope field. Write the most specific practical answer.
explanation: A thin, irregular intimal lining of synoviocytes overlies loose vascular connective tissue without a basement membrane or true epithelium. This is synovium, the membrane lining the non-articular inner surface of a synovial joint capsule.

distractorExplanations.B: A true simple squamous epithelium forms a continuous sheet on a basement membrane; synovial intima is discontinuous and has no basement membrane.
distractorExplanations.C: The fibrous capsule is dense collagenous connective tissue, whereas this field shows the delicate cellular synovial lining and loose subintima.
distractorExplanations.D: Articular cartilage contains chondrocytes in lacunae within a glassy zoned matrix and has no synovial intimal lining over its free surface.

learningObjective: Recognize Synovium (synovial membrane) across unfamiliar stains, species, fields and magnifications, and distinguish its closest Aug 22 practical look-alikes.

prompt: Identify the tissue or dominant lining pattern in this unfamiliar microscope field. Write the most specific practical answer.

distractorExplanations.D: Dense regular tissue has flattened fibroblast nuclei between parallel collagen bundles but no chondrocytes in lacunae.
